Role :   Data Product Manager

About Carrier

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort,   safety   and sustainability to life. Through   cutting-edge   advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air   quality   and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical   industries   and ensure safe transport of food, life-saving medicines and more. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the   center   of   everything we do. For more information, visit   corporate.carrier.com   or follow Carrier on social media at @Carrier.

About the role
We are hiring a Data Product Manager to drive end-to-end data product development and program delivery across business units. This role requires a combination of data product ownership, stakeholder management, and project execution experience.

Key Responsibilities
Data Product Ownership & Strategy
- Define and own the vision, roadmap, and backlog for data products aligned to business priorities
- Translate business requirements into scalable data products such as datasets, dashboards, APIs, and analytics solutions
- Drive product lifecycle management from ideation, design, build, testing to deployment and continuous improvement
- Ensure reusability and standardization using data product frameworks (medallion architecture, semantic layer)
- Prioritize backlog based on business impact, feasibility, and platform strategy
- Build and maintain value realization dashboards for leadership
- Continuously refine products based on usage insights and feedback

Business Stakeholder Engagement
- Act as the primary interface between business units and data teams
- Collaborate with stakeholders to identify high-impact use cases
- Convert ambiguous business problems into structured, data-driven solutions
- Drive alignment through regular stakeholder reviews, demos, and feedback loops
- Ensure high adoption by focusing on user experience and business outcomes

End-to-End Project Ownership
- Manage multiple concurrent data initiatives across business units
- Define and track project scope, milestones, timelines, risks, and dependencies
- Lead delivery using Agile / Scrum or hybrid models
- Ensure coordination across data engineering, analytics, visualization, and business teams
- Proactively manage risks, escalations, and issue resolution
- Manage delivery through external vendors and partners
- Ensure alignment to SOW, timelines, and SLAs
- Monitor vendor performance and quality of deliverables
- Drive accountability and resolve delivery bottlenecks

Cross-Functional Team Leadership
- Drive collaboration across Data Platform, Engineering, BI, Governance and vendors teams
- Ensure teams are aligned on goals, priorities, and delivery timelines
- Ensure all data products align with enterprise data platform strategy (Lakehouse, AWS/GCP)
- Collaborate with architecture teams to ensure Scalability and performance, Data quality, lineage, and governance compliance.
- Promote data reuse and asset standardization across use cases and drive adoption of best practices in data modeling and design

Experience
- 10–15 years in Data / Analytics / Product / Program Management roles
- Experience in managing large-scale data or analytics projects
- Exposure to cross-functional and global teams
- Experience in Manufacturing domain preferred

Benefits

We are committed to offering competitive benefits programs for all of our employees, and enhancing our programs when necessary.
- Make yourself a priority with flexible schedules, parental leave
- Drive forward your career through professional development opportunities
- Achieve your personal goals with our Employee Assistance Programme

Our commitment to you

Our greatest assets are the expertise, creativity and passion of our employees. We strive to provide a great place to work that attracts, develops and retains the best talent, promotes employee engagement, fosters teamwork and ultimately drives innovation for the benefit of our customers. We strive to create an environment where you feel that you belong, with diversity and inclusion as the engine to growth and innovation. We develop and deploy best-in-class programs and practices, providing enriching career opportunities, listening to employee feedback and always challenging ourselves to do better. This is The Carrier Way.

Join us and make a difference.

Apply Now!

The Associate Director, Residential Product Management is responsible for leading the strategic direction, roadmaps, new product development, portfolio lifecycle management, annual planning and commercialization of split systems and SPP (small, packaged products).  This role will work closely with sales, engineering, manufacturing, and sourcing to launch innovative products that meet regulations and customer needs.

- 5+ years of people management experience
- Background or experience in HVAC engineering &/or product management
- Passion for servicing customers.  Ability to listen to customers’ needs and quickly act to solve their problems, provide quality solutions, and go above and beyond to exceed their expectations

About the role

The Data Product Manager is responsible for driving the successful delivery, adoption, and long‑term value of data products across data domains hosted on GCP. This includes areas such as parts and service, pricing, lead generation, external data integration, and broader commercial analytics. The role blends customer-facing leadership with strong data engineering and data product creation skills, ensuring that solutions are built on modern open lake house architecture and aligned with Carrier's business priorities. This leader partners with cross‑functional teams to translate business objectives into scalable, production‑ready data products that support enterprise transformation.

Duties & Responsibilities

- Lead discovery sessions with stakeholders in parts, pricing, sales operations, marketing, service, and analytics to define data product requirements and measurable outcomes.

- Build strong relationships with customer stakeholders to ensure alignment, transparency, and sustained value realization.

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Legislation, Regulation & Conformity Product Manager

Summary
This role manages all legislative, regulatory and conformity requirements across the HVAC, renewables, heating, cooling, controls and related product portfolio, ensuring products remain compliant, market-ready, commercially viable and supported by robust technical evidence throughout their lifecycle, while also providing forward-looking regulatory insight to guide long-term product strategy, sustainability commitments and market-access planning.

Job Description
Role Responsibilities
- Monitor, interpret, and communicate applicable legislation, standards, and conformity requirements, ensuring regulatory changes are translated into clear product actions and business requirements.

- Manage product conformity activities including UKCA, CE, Declarations of Conformity, technical files, certification routes, test evidence, approval documentation, and product labelling.

- Support product roadmaps, new product introductions, product modifications, phase-outs, and portfolio transitions through regulatory impact assessment and lifecycle governance.

- Coordinate cross-functional activity with product management, engineering, quality, service, sales, marketing, procurement, suppliers, certification bodies, and senior stakeholders to maintain compliant and competitive product portfolios.

- Identify, assess, and escalate regulatory, technical, environmental, safety, and commercial risks arising from legislation changes, supplier changes, product changes, and market policy developments.

- Maintain accurate compliance evidence, certification status records, technical documentation, decision records, audit trails, and product lifecycle governance information.

- Provide regulatory and conformity guidance to internal teams and external partners on product eligibility, market-entry requirements, compliance constraints, customer queries, and technical positioning.

- Represent Carrier in external regulatory forums, industry associations, notified bodies, and policy consultations to ensure early visibility of regulatory change and influence future standards.
· Conduct structured horizon scanning to forecast regulatory impacts, refrigerant transitions, efficiency uplifts, and policy changes affecting future product strategy.

- Deliver internal compliance training, guidance documents, and knowledge-transfer sessions to sales, service, engineering, and product teams.

- Review and approve compliance-related marketing claims, technical brochures, and customer-facing documentation to ensure accuracy and legal conformity.

- Manage digital compliance systems, Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) records, and technical file repositories to ensure audit readiness and lifecycle traceability. · Support sustainability evidence generation including Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs), Life Cycle Assessments (LCAs), embodied-carbon reporting, and environmental compliance documentation.

Regulatory and Product Scope
- The role covers regulation as a product and market-access framework, connecting compliance obligations to product design, certification evidence, lifecycle risk, environmental responsibility, and portfolio strategy.
- Market access: UKCA, CE marking, Declarations of Conformity, technical files, testing evidence, product labelling, and certification routes.
- Product design: Ecodesign, energy labelling, efficiency metrics, refrigerant choice, controls, integration requirements, and safety-related design constraints.
- Safety compliance: Gas, pressure equipment, electrical safety, EMC, radio equipment, machinery, installation, and risk-assessment requirements.
- Environmental lifecycle: F-Gas, RoHS, refrigerant management, hazardous substances, embodied carbon, EPDs, and sustainability evidence.
- Policy transition: Building Regulations, Future Homes Standard, Clean Heat Market Mechanism, decarbonisation policy, and boiler-to-heat-pump transition planning.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience in product management, technical compliance, legislation, regulation, certification, or conformity within HVAC, renewables, heat pumps, boilers, cooling, heating, controls, or related commercial systems.

- Strong working knowledge of UK and EU product legislation, conformity assessment processes, certification evidence, technical files, and product approval requirements.

- Ability to interpret legislation, standards, and regulatory guidance and convert them into product specifications, risk assessments, launch requirements, decision records, and lifecycle actions.

- Commercial awareness with the ability to balance compliance obligations, profitability, customer expectations, portfolio strategy, and market timing.

- Experience engaging with external regulatory bodies, notified bodies, test laboratories, and certification agencies.

- Experience delivering internal compliance training or supporting organisational capability development.

- Familiarity with digital compliance tools, Product Lifecycle Management systems (PLM) systems, and structured technical documentation management.

Skills and Behaviours
- Strong analytical judgement, attention to detail, written communication, presentation, negotiation, stakeholder management, and influencing skills.
- Ability to work effectively across sales, engineering, quality, service, marketing, suppliers, certification agencies, regulatory bodies, and senior leadership.
- Competent in Microsoft Office, CRM systems, product management tools, reporting, presentations, and data-led decision support.
- Self-driven, organised, commercially aware, collaborative, and able to manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy, compliance, and delivery discipline.
- Ability to forecast regulatory trends and translate them into long-term product strategy.
- Ability to validate and approve compliance-related marketing claims and technical positioning.
- Strong capability in sustainability compliance and environmental evidence interpretation.

Working Conditions
- The role may require travel within the UK to support product, supplier, customer, training, certification, or internal business activities. A full clean UK driving licence is required.
- Occasional travel to external regulatory bodies, notified bodies, test labs, and industry working groups may be required.

About this role
The Senior Manager, Digital Product Management will define and lead the digital roadmap for our Data Center cooling portfolio. This role is responsible for embedding digital capabilities — including telemetry, analytics, controls integration, and platform interoperability — into mission-critical cooling systems.
This is a product management role first. The ideal candidate is a practiced PM who owns roadmaps, drives customer discovery, aligns cross-functional teams, and ships products — and brings that craft to a domain they know well: data center infrastructure. You will shape how cooling infrastructure evolves into connected, intelligent, and energy-aware systems aligned to hyperscale and colocation expectations.
Reports directly to Head of Products, DPX.

Key Responsibilities
Digital Platform Strategy
- Define the multi-year digital strategy for Data Center cooling systems, spanning: - Embedded telemetry and edge intelligence
- Cloud-based monitoring and diagnostics
- Predictive performance analytics
- Optimization and control strategies
- API-driven integration frameworks

- Establish digital architecture and data requirements to ensure scalability and interoperability.
- Embed digital capabilities into new product development from early concept phases.

Data Center Market & Segment Leadership
- Translate data center operational requirements into product strategy, including redundancy models (N, N+1, 2N), commissioning timelines, high-density rack deployments, and liquid/hybrid cooling architectures.
- Define digital differentiation across hyperscale, colocation, enterprise, and edge segments.
- Conduct competitive benchmarking focused on digital maturity and ecosystem positioning.
- Support strategic customer engagements where digital capabilities influence infrastructure decisions.

Competitive Digital Differentiation
- Define how digital capabilities improve uptime visibility, operational performance, service enablement, and lifecycle optimization.
- Identify and develop monetizable digital services aligned to cooling infrastructure.
- Establish KPIs tied to digital adoption, utilization, and service expansion.

Energy & Infrastructure Convergence
- Identify where cooling systems intersect with PUE optimization, load balancing, energy visibility, and grid-aware operational strategies.
- Develop roadmap elements supporting energy-aware cooling solutions.
- Align digital strategy with broader infrastructure and energy initiatives.

Investment & Portfolio Leadership
- Develop structured business cases tied to revenue growth and lifecycle value.
- Recommend build, partner, or acquisition pathways to accelerate capability development.
- Provide clear roadmap updates and investment recommendations to senior leadership.

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree
- 5+ years of experience in data center infrastructure, mission-critical cooling, and/or precision HVAC environments.
- 5+ years of hands-on product management experience owing a roadmap, defining requirements, and driving products from concept through launch in a B2B or enterprise context.

Preferred Qualifications
- Direct experience working with hyperscale, colocation, or enterprise data center operators.
- Experience participating in system-level architecture discussions, deployments, or commissioning activities.
- Demonstrated experience shaping product strategy beyond sustaining lifecycle management.
- Experience integrating physical systems with digital platforms, controls, or monitoring ecosystems.
- Strong commercial and financial acumen.
- Experience with liquid cooling architectures or high-density AI deployments.
- Experience competing in or against major data center infrastructure providers.
- Familiarity with DCIM platforms, BMS/BAS integrations, or digital monitoring ecosystems.

About Carrier

About the role
The Financial Systems Implementation Lead is responsible for leading the successful deployment of enterprise financial systems across planning, configuration, integration, testing, data readiness, deployment, and adoption. This role serves as a critical liaison between Finance, business stakeholders, Digital Technology teams, implementation partners, and functional workstreams to ensure solutions are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned to business objectives.

This position plays a key role in large-scale transformation initiatives, including ERP implementations, finance transformation programs, process standardization, automation, and related technology deployments. The role requires a hands-on implementation leader who can translate strategic objectives into practical, scalable solutions while driving cross-functional alignment, issue resolution, and business readiness.

The ideal candidate brings deep implementation experience, strong finance and business process knowledge, structured project delivery skills, and the ability to influence stakeholders in a global, matrixed environment. They are comfortable navigating ambiguity, managing complex initiatives, and driving sustainable adoption of new processes and technologies.

Key Responsibilities
Program & Project Delivery
- Lead financial systems implementation workstreams from planning through deployment, stabilization, and hypercare.
- Partner with Finance, business stakeholders, Digital Technology, vendors, and implementation partners to define scope, objectives, requirements, and success criteria.
- Develop and manage implementation plans, timelines, dependencies, risks, mitigation strategies, and key delivery milestones.
- Coordinate cross-functional execution across business, technology, vendor, and project teams to maintain alignment and accountability.
- Monitor project progress, communicate status, and escalate risks, issues, and decisions to leadership and stakeholders.

Business Process & Solution Design
- Analyze current-state finance and business processes to identify opportunities for standardization, simplification, automation, and control improvement.
- Facilitate workshops to gather business requirements, align stakeholders, and document future-state process designs.
- Translate business requirements into functional solution designs that support scalable finance operations and enterprise transformation goals.
- Ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture standards, finance process objectives, internal controls, and strategic priorities.
- Promote leading practices and process discipline while minimizing unnecessary customization and operational complexity.

System Configuration & Integration
- Partner with Digital Technology teams to design, validate, and govern system integrations, data flows, and upstream/downstream dependencies.

- Review configuration and integration designs to confirm business requirements, finance process needs, and control expectations are met.

- Drive issue resolution, defect management, and decision-making throughout the implementation lifecycle.

- Coordinate with vendors, implementation partners, and system integrators to ensure solution delivery activities are completed with quality and accountability.

Testing & Deployment
- Drive implementation testing strategies, including system integration testing, user acceptance testing, regression testing, and deployment validation.
- Coordinate Finance and business participation during testing cycles to ensure coverage, accountability, and timely issue resolution.
- Manage defect tracking, prioritization, root-cause analysis, and resolution efforts in partnership with technology and implementation teams.
- Oversee cutover planning, deployment readiness reviews, go-live execution, and post-go-live support.
- Ensure a disciplined transition into production operations, including support readiness, knowledge transfer, and stabilization activities.

Data Migration & Quality
- Lead data conversion, validation, reconciliation, and migration activities for financial systems implementations.
- Establish and enforce controls to ensure data accuracy, completeness, integrity, and auditability.
- Partner with Finance, business, and technology teams to resolve data quality issues and confirm ownership of remediation actions.
- Validate migrated data, coordinate reconciliation activities, and support formal business sign-off processes.

Change Management & Adoption
- Lead organizational readiness and change management activities to support successful adoption of new financial systems, processes, and ways of working.
- Coordinate development of training materials, job aids, communications, and user support documentation.
- Conduct stakeholder briefings and coordinate end-user training and knowledge transfer sessions.
- Drive stakeholder engagement, adoption, and sustained usage of new processes and technologies across impacted teams.

Governance & Controls
- Ensure adherence to project governance standards, finance controls, compliance requirements, and implementation methodology.
- Identify implementation risks, control considerations, escalation needs, and decision points that may affect scope, timeline, quality, or adoption.
- Support audit, security, SOX, access, and internal control requirements throughout the implementation lifecycle.
- Maintain project documentation, decision logs, design approvals, control evidence, and implementation artifacts.

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree
- 7 + years of experience leading enterprise system implementations, involving ERP, financial systems, finance transformation, and/or related enterprise platforms with demonstrated experience owning implementation workstreams across planning, requirements, design, configuration, testing, deployment, stabilization, and/or adoption.
- 10 + years of experience with implementation methodologies, SDLC practices, project governance, and/or structured delivery frameworks
- Managed at least 3 projects with cross-functional initiatives involving business teams, Digital Technology, vendors, and/or implementation partners.
- 10 + years of experience with requirements gathering, process design, testing coordination, defect management, data validation, cutover, and/or deployment readiness.
- 10 + years of knowledge and understanding of finance processes, financial controls, data flows, reconciliation, and/or system-enabled business operations.
- 7 + years of demonstration of strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence, communicate with leadership, and drive alignment in a matrixed environment.

Preferred Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business, Finance, or Engineering
- Experience with SAP S/4HANA, Central Finance (CFIN), SAP Group Reporting, SAP BTP, or similar enterprise finance platforms.
- Experience supporting large-scale ERP, finance transformation, global process standardization, or shared services initiatives.
- Experience with finance processes such as record-to-report, consolidation, planning, close, reporting, master data, controls, or reconciliation.
